subject: Application for Junior Python Developer - Berat Altinsuyu
email_body:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Junior Python Developer position at Antigravity Corp. As a Computer Engineering student with a solid background in backend development and a focus on building robust APIs, I am confident that my technical skills align well with your team's needs.

During my internship at VakıfBank in Payment Systems, I gained practical experience in developing and maintaining RESTful API endpoints using .NET Core and performing complex SQL operations. In addition to my C# experience, I have developed a strong proficiency in Python and FastAPI, which I have applied in various academic and personal projects. My technical toolkit includes SQL databases, Git, Docker, and Postman, all of which I use to ensure high-quality code and system reliability.

I am particularly drawn to Antigravity Corp because of your commitment to technical excellence. I am eager to bring my problem-solving skills and passion for backend architecture to your development team.

Please find my CV attached for your review. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my background in API development and database management can contribute to the success of your ongoing projects. Thank you for your time and consideration.

Best regards,

Berat Altinsuyu
